title: build(deps): bump github/gh-aw-actions/setup from 0.87.10 to 0.88.4
author: app/dependabot
summary: The current upstream head mixes a v0.88.4 gh-aw setup bump with generated v0.87.10 workflow metadata. That mismatch is a valid incompatibility, so the PR needs to either revert the bump or regenerate the workflow lock as one coherent gh-aw bundle before merge.

status.label: Request-changes review ready
status.detail: Context revalidated after the unchanged-head maintainer approval and /azp run. The live head 1529d1fd081919a415bbf7ab38ae14ae1c528536 still pins github/gh-aw-actions/setup to v0.88.4 while the generated lock metadata and gh-aw manifest remain on v0.87.10. The x64 CI failure was an MSB3061 cleanup file lock on mfc140chs.dll, not a contradictory gh-aw result. The fork-side revert commit 9d7c5302db1d24a8a7b6009586857b31a39fae50 remains a valid exact-head fix and should be applied upstream or recreated by regenerating the lockfile before merge.
